problem_statement:
Response.is_client_error and Response.is_server_error

`Response.ok` lumps every status below 400 together. Please add two read-only properties to `requests.models.Response`:

- `is_client_error`: True when `status_code` is between 400 and 499 inclusive.
- `is_server_error`: True when `status_code` is between 500 and 599 inclusive.

Both are False when `status_code` is `None`.
